pairs: Factum est autem cum perfecisset Salomon ædificium domus Domini,
when Solomon had perfected the building of the house of the Lord,
and all that he had desired and had willed to do,
the Lord appeared to him a second time,
just as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
And the Lord said to him:
Exaudivi orationem tuam et deprecationem tuam,
“I have heard your prayer and your petition,
I have sanctified this house, which you have built,
ut ponerem nomen meum ibi in sempiternum,
so that I may place my name there forever,
et erunt oculi mei et cor meum ibi cunctis diebus.
and so that my eyes and my heart will be there for all days.
Tu quoque si ambulaveris coram me sicut ambulavit pater tuus,
if you will walk before me,
et feceris omnia quæ præcepi tibi,
in simplicity of heart and in equity,
and you do all that I have instructed to you,
and you keep my laws and my judgments,
ponam thronum regni tui super Israël in sempiternum,
then I will set the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever,
sicut locutus sum David patri tuo,
just as I promised your father David,
Non auferetur vir de genere tuo de solio Israël.
‘A man from your stock shall not be taken away from the throne of Israel.’
Si autem aversione aversi fueritis vos
But if you and your sons,
et cæremonias meas quas proposui vobis,
and not keeping my commandments and my ceremonies,
which I have proposed to you,
and you serve strange gods and adore them,
auferam Israël de superficie terræ quam dedi eis,
then I will take away Israel from the face of the land,
et templum quod sanctificavi nomini meo,
which I have given to them. And the temple,
which I have sanctified to my name,
eritque Israël in proverbium, et in fabulam cunctis populis.
I will cast out from my sight. And Israel will be a proverb and a parable among all the peoples.
Et domus hæc erit in exemplum:
And this house will become an example:
omnis qui transierit per eam, stupebit,
anyone who passes by it will be stupefied,
and he will hiss and say,
Quare fecit Dominus sic terræ huic, et domui huic?
‘Why has the Lord acted in this way to this land and to this house?’
‘Because they abandoned the Lord their God,
qui eduxit patres eorum de terra Ægypti,
who led their fathers away from the land of Egypt,
and they adored them and served them.
idcirco induxit Dominus super eos omne malum hoc.
the Lord led all this evil over them.’”
Expletis autem annis viginti postquam ædificaverat Salomon duas domos,
Then, when twenty years were fulfilled, after Solomon had built the two houses,
and the house of the king,
(Hiram rege Tyri præbente Salomoni ligna cedrina et abiegna,
Hiram, the king of Tyre, having supplied Solomon with cedar wood,
et aurum juxta omne quod opus habuerat),
and spruce wood, and gold, in accord with all that he needed,
tunc dedit Salomon Hiram viginti oppida in terra Galilææ.
then Solomon gave Hiram twenty towns in the land of Galilee.
Et egressus est Hiram de Tyro ut videret oppida quæ dederat ei Salomon,
And Hiram went out of Tyre, so that he might view the towns that Solomon had given to him.
And they did not please him.
Hæccine sunt civitates quas dedisti mihi,
“Are these the cities that you have given to me,
And he called them the land of Cabul,
Misit quoque Hiram ad regem Salomonem centum viginti talenta auri.
And Hiram sent to king Solomon one hundred twenty talents of gold.
Hæc est summa expensarum quam obtulit rex Salomon ad ædificandam domum Domini
This is the sum of the expenses that king Solomon offered for the building of the house of the Lord,
and he burned it with fire.
And he put to death the Canaanite who was living in the city,
and he gave it as a dowry for his daughter,
et dedit eam in dotem filiæ suæ uxori Salomonis.
and Palmira in the land of the wilderness.
Et omnes vicos qui ad se pertinebant
And all the towns which belonged to him,
along with the cities of the chariots,
and the cities of the horsemen,
et quodcumque ei placuit ut ædificaret in Jerusalem,
and whatever was pleasing to him that he might build in Jerusalem,
et in omni terra potestatis suæ.
and in the entire land of his dominion.
Universum populum qui remanserat de Amorrhæis,
All the people who had remained of the Amorites,
qui non sunt de filiis Israël:
who were not of the sons of Israel,
horum filios qui remanserant in terra,
their sons, who had remained in the land,
quos scilicet non potuerant filii Israël exterminare,
namely, those whom the sons of Israel had not been able to destroy,
fecit Salomon tributarios usque in diem hanc.
Solomon made tributary, even to this day.
De filiis autem Israël non constituit Salomon servire quemquam,
But from the sons of Israel,
Solomon did not appoint anyone at all to serve,
and the overseers of the chariots and the horses.
Erant autem principes super omnia opera Salomonis præpositi quingenti quinquaginta,
Now there were five hundred fifty leaders in the first place over all the works of Solomon,
and they had people subject to them,
and these were given orders for the appointed works.
Filia autem Pharaonis ascendit de civitate David in domum suam,
And the daughter of Pharaoh went up from the city of David to her house,
which Solomon had built for her.
Solomon offered holocausts and victims of peace offerings,
et pacificas victimas super altare quod ædificaverat Domino,
upon the altar that he had built to the Lord,
and he burned incense before the Lord.
Classem quoque fecit rex Salomon in Asiongaber,
And king Solomon made a navy at Ezion Geber,
quæ est juxta Ailath in littore maris Rubri,
which is beside Eloth, on the shores of the Red Sea,
Misitque Hiram in classe illa servos suos viros nauticos
And Hiram sent his servants to that navy,
the sailors and those knowledgeable about the sea,
And when they had gone to Ophir,
sumptum inde aurum quadringentorum viginti talentorum,
taking from there four hundred twenty talents of gold,
they brought it to king Solomon.
